P01.rationale: A large portrait of a founder is used as the dominant human anchor in the bottom section.

P05.rationale: The case studies are present but lack clearly framed client portraits; they rely on generic avatars or initials instead of meaningful named photos.

P07.rationale: A robust social-proof apparatus is present in the form of a Trustpilot rating card and a grid of specific customer testimonials.

P10.rationale: Oversized decorative typographic elements are present as large percentage numerals (58%, 61%) acting as visual anchors for data.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualisations bound to numbers are used effectively in the center of the page with specific percentages and source citations.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text blocks and visual elements.

P13.rationale: There is no intentional background texture or atmosphere; the design relies on flat solid colors and white space rather than atmospheric depth.

P14.rationale: The full-bleed photo at the bottom is treated with a dark overlay (scrim) to ensure that overlaid text remains readable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup is shown; the page relies on typography and photography rather than physical product representation.

N07.rationale: The imagery looks somewhat generic/stock (e.g., the construction worker photo) rather than specific to a real business context.

N08.rationale: There is minimal sparse dead whitespace; the layout is generally dense and fills the page effectively.

N10.rationale: Text sits on a busy photo in the bottom section without sufficient contrast or separation from the background elements.
